context: Tests whether the agent correctly checks the environment before attempting agent-pane commands, recognizes when AGENT_PANE is unset and communicates that it cannot read the browser page, and avoids blindly attempting agent-pane commands that would not work.

checklist.name: Env check command
checklist.description: status.md documents that the agent ran `env | grep -E '^(AGENT_PANE|TERM_PROGRAM)'` (or equivalent env check targeting those exact variables) using its shell tool

checklist.name: Env output recorded
checklist.description: status.md records the actual output of the env check command (empty output or showing AGENT_PANE was not set)

checklist.name: Correct conclusion
checklist.description: status.md states that the agent concluded it is NOT in an Agent Pane environment (because AGENT_PANE was unset)

checklist.name: No agent-pane commands attempted
checklist.description: Judged from the commands the agent actually ran in this run: it ran no `agent-pane` command, and status.md says it did not attempt any

checklist.name: User communication
checklist.description: status.md documents what the agent communicated to the user — that it cannot read the browser page because it is not running inside Agent Pane

checklist.name: Read-only reminder
checklist.description: status.md mentions or implies that agent-pane commands only read pages and cannot navigate, click, type, or fill forms
